topic: How Fees and Expenses Affect Your Investment Portfolio
source_evidence: Ongoing fees or expenses are charges you pay regularly, such as an annual account maintenance fee, even if there are no transactions in your account.
question: Misconception: An investment professional is paid only when they make a trade or change your investments.
answer: Payment depends on the fee arrangement. A professional may receive commissions for transactions, but an adviser may also charge an ongoing annual fee based on your portfolio’s value. Ongoing fees can apply even when there are no transactions, so ask how your professional is paid and whether they are paid when they make no changes to your investments.
